resolved_findings.trigger: A synchronous cancellation or scope-release callback starts a replacement request.
resolved_findings.defect: An older cancel/leave frame could overwrite the replacement pending state before its later epoch check.
resolved_findings.resolution: Immediate epoch checks after loader cancellation; detached active/pending state before releasing the captured scope; checks after release, deactivate and trim.
resolved_findings.validation: Static inspection only. New cancellation callback probes inspected, not executed. No ordinary bundled-host failure was reproduced.

runtime_proof_gaps: Whole-scene sibling disposal, callback and resource-release ordering.
Final claim failure after successful preflight and callbacks during successful view handoff.
Owner retirement while a real Store request is already dispatched, followed by its delayed response.
